title: Implants emitted radio signals during Japanese TV filming

tellings.quote: And but they started giving off they started giving off radio signals during a Japanese TV show I was I was uh filming.

plain: Objects said to be alien implants taken from people's bodies started giving off radio signals while a Japanese TV show was being filmed. That is what Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies such implants, says he saw himself, since he was there for the filming. If true, the objects would be active devices sending signals, not inert bits of material.
